channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The buyers are spreading their bets and the suppliers are locking in theirs. At Oracle AI World on Tuesday, Oracle said Google TPUs will be available on OCI in calendar 2027, the first time Google has put TPUs in another hyperscaler's cloud, and Cerebras inference is planned for OCI in 2027 as well. In the same hour Oracle and Nvidia said OCI will take Vera Rubin NVL72 to multi-gigawatt scale, on Oracle's own Acceleron networking with Spectrum-X; no deal value was given. On Wednesday SK hynix reported third-quarter revenue of 104.6 trillion won and operating profit of 83.3 trillion won, an 80% margin, said 2027 HBM volumes and prices are settled with major customers, and said long-term agreements with 14 customers cover more than half of its 2027 and 2028 capacity. Supply is being sold years forward at rising prices while demand is being split across more chip families. On the public tape, DigitalOcean lifted AMD spot back up: MI355X $2.97 to $4.50 and MI350X $2.46 to $3.00 per GPU-hour. The other 68 prints confirmed.

item.title: Compute brief - 28 October 2026
item.description: The buyers are spreading their bets and the suppliers are locking in theirs. At Oracle AI World on Tuesday, Oracle said Google TPUs will be available on OCI in calendar 2027, the first time Google has put TPUs in another hyperscaler's cloud, and Cerebras inference is planned for OCI in 2027 as well. In the same hour Oracle and Nvidia said OCI will take Vera Rubin NVL72 to multi-gigawatt scale, on Oracle's own Acceleron networking with Spectrum-X; no deal value was given. On Wednesday SK hynix reported third-quarter revenue of 104.6 trillion won and operating profit of 83.3 trillion won, an 80% margin, said 2027 HBM volumes and prices are settled with major customers, and said long-term agreements with 14 customers cover more than half of its 2027 and 2028 capacity. Supply is being sold years forward at rising prices while demand is being split across more chip families. On the public tape, DigitalOcean lifted AMD spot back up: MI355X $2.97 to $4.50 and MI350X $2.46 to $3.00 per GPU-hour. The other 68 prints confirmed. Countries: South Korea: Climate minister says only confirmed AI data centre demand goes into the 12th power plan, after the forecast was raised to 11.9 GW in August (Wire, 26 Oct). India: OneQode signs 14 MW with AdaniConneX in Chennai on AMD Instinct, in talks for up to 114 MW (Wire, 28 Oct). Switzerland: Swiss Government Cloud tender: up to CHF 7 billion over 14 years in three lots, one lot per bidder (Wire, 20 Oct). Norway: Crusoe takes Polar's 40 MW DRA02 at Tørdal for Vera Rubin NVL72, live late 2027; DRA01 live at 12 MW (Wire, 21 Oct). Czechia: Bull and CRA sign a non-binding MoU for the Czech AI Gigafactory bid (Wire, 21 Oct). Oman: Yamna to build an AI data centre in Salalah, first phase over £1 billion, MoU stage (Wire, 21 Oct). Greece: G42's Khazna and Core42 sign exploratory MoUs with Copelouzos for an AI factory (Wire, 22 Oct).
